source_or_driver_coverage: Dynamic metadata and live device token/recycle preparation inside timers are frozen-source checks, not runtime tracing.
Gate bridge snapshots show values after execution; physical D2D task order is established by captured source, not new trace.
Gate A/B eager, dirty/reset numerical comparisons are raw auditable; timed C1 floats and warmup floats are not saved.
Warmup/seed equality, full injected prefix preservation, addresses, graph counters and memory peaks are driver records.
One-graph lifecycle is supported by frozen source and closed journal entries; no independent allocator event trace exists.
Actual NPU weights/head hashes are driver records; expected projection shards are independently hashed from checkpoint.
Same-position metadata tensors are compared in full; rotary tables are not independently regenerated from trigonometry.
Health snapshots show final state and external process identities, not continuous external-job behavior.
Stage includes host candidate reads and metadata; excludes seed/reset/capture, conditioned M4, target, acceptance and TPOT.
